**1. Start with the test records:** Obtain a standard checklist or record sheet to document all checks and results. Don't forget to include details like the date of test, name of the tester, and appliance details including make/model, serial number, and location. Ensure you have a clear identification system so each appliance can be traced back to its record.

**2. Thoroughly inspect each appliance:** Begin with a physical examination. Look for obvious signs of damage, wear, or misuse. Check for loss of integrity in the casing or significant dirt accumulation that might impede functionality or safety.
